name: nxsched_foreach

ownership.argument: This is the task iterator the loop capture needs: callback signature is (tcb, arg), matching what astrolink already uses. Note the iteration visits one TCB per pid-hash bucket, so on this build the hash carries a single TCB per bucket; if a bucket ever chains, the chain is not followed here.

provenance.source: Walks the scheduler's pid hash under the critical section (BASEPRI 0x80 via 0xC205EB4/0xC205EE8): buckets at 0x200B24B0, bucket count at 0x200B24AC, and calls worker(bucket_tcb, arg) for every non-null entry. Reached from the firmware's own global file release 0xC1B9F1C, which calls it with the worker 0xC1B8D50, and from four more scheduler/cleanup callers.
